ZUBEEN_GARG.name: Zubeen Garg
ZUBEEN_GARG.subtitle: The Voice of Assam
ZUBEEN_GARG.award: National Film Award — Best Male Playback (Mayabini)
ZUBEEN_GARG.legacy: A defining cultural figure of modern Assam, spanning Assamese popular music, Bihu, Bengali and Hindi cinema for over three decades.
ZUBEEN_GARG.diedNote: Died in Singapore on 19 September 2025, aged 52, while performing at the Northeast Festival — an unprecedented wave of mourning across Assam.

assamArtists.name: Bhupen Hazarika
assamArtists.knownFor: Singer · Songwriter · Filmmaker · National Poet of Assam
assamArtists.bio: Mahapurush Bhupen Hazarika is Assam's most celebrated cultural icon. Composer of 'Jiyori', 'O Mor Apunar Dekh' and 'Bhey Bhikhari', he carried Assam's pain and pride to the nation and beyond.

assamArtists.name: Bishnu Prasad Rabha
assamArtists.bio: Rupkonwar Bishnu Prasad Rabha shaped modern Assamese culture — music, drama, the Sattriya renaissance and the Assam trunk road (BRT). A true Renaissance man of Assam.

assamArtists.name: Jyoti Prasad Agarwala
assamArtists.knownFor: Director · Playwright · Lyricist · Pioneer of Assamese cinema
assamArtists.bio: The first filmmaker of Assam — directed, wrote and composed the first Assamese feature film 'Joymati' (1935) and wrote the classic 'Jiyori'. A colossus of Assamese literature and theatre.

assamArtists.name: Dr. Anima Choudhury
assamArtists.bio: A rare living link to Assam's sacred musical heritage — a noted vocalist of Borgeets and Manipuri music, carrying forward the musical lineage of Assam's greatest tradition.

assamArtists.name: Zubeen Garg
assamArtists.bio: Over three decades, Zubeen Garg defined a generation of Assamese music — from the Bihu anthem 'Mayabini' and 'Ya Ali' in Hindi cinema to Assamese films like 'Mission China'. A global voice of Assamese soul.

assamArtists.name: Srimanta Sankardev
assamArtists.bio: The 15th-century saint, poet and playwright who unified Assam under Vaishnavism — founder of Sattriya dance, Borgeet and the Bhaona theatre.

assamArtists.name: Mahapurush Madhavdeva
assamArtists.bio: The soul of Assamese devotional music — composed the Bhawaiya and Borgeet, and wrote the devotional play Patassara.

assamArtists.name: Lakshminath Bezbaroa
assamArtists.bio: Assam's national poet, writer and journalist — author of the state song 'O Mur Apunar Dekh' and the iconic 'Joi Aai Axom'.

assamArtists.name: Sheila K. Bharali
assamArtists.bio: A powerful voice of contemporary Assamese folk and patriotic songs, carrying the Bihu and folk traditions forward.
